headline: Visa Brings Onchain Lending Closer to Everyday Stablecoin Payments
summary: Visa introduces an onchain credit model combining VisaNet settlement data with blockchain lending to help stablecoin-linked card programs access working capital.

headline: S&P 500, Nasdaq Slip as $98 Brent Reignites Inflation Fears: Stock Market Today
summary: Crude near $98 pushes the 10-year Treasury yield above 4.8% for the first time since 2023, hammering the Dow as traders price a Fed rate hike next week.
